cases.basis: Exact source event kinds + pinned term.c::ESCAPE_HORIZ (clear BACKAFTER/consume BACKBEFORE before writing remaining native fixed blanks), roff_escape.c quoted HORIZ parse, html.c::print_encode HORIZ omission, and selected ManT one-space reading-motion contract. Positive author SP/NBSP before HORIZ starts payload, so that later motion stays internal. Native/HTML visible strings are separately recorded; neither candidate nor before output is read.
limits: Do not assert full consumer row is native fixed device whitespace: selected reading projection approximates positive literal motion by one SP and owns responsive word spacing.
Code/Link content-start must use typed source event provenance, never trim(char::is_whitespace), visible first char, or forged older source epoch.
